summary.scope: Existing record integrity and source inspection; no solver, simulation, native validation or formal proof executed.

routecast_abba.scope: One ABBA block largest mux case, shared context excludes setup; no end-to-end, statistical confidence or general pressure accuracy claim.

gates.requirement: Frozen inputs, baseline sources and commands; true layer/SLR metadata; graph and route round trip
C++ complete routing closure with exact occupancy, net sharing, corridor release/repair, deterministic transactions and five-repeat hashes
At least one credible multi-die workload cohort plus parameterized topology/capacity scaling; microbenchmarks alone insufficient
Native legality; route failures do not increase; SLL use, CPD and wirelength do not degrade relative to frozen strong baselines
E-DR1 reservation, E-DR2 mapping, E-DR3 shadow, E-DR4 migration, E-DR5 topology ablations
HLS csim/csynth/cosim; actual HBM interfaces and connectivity; U280 implementation timing and resource reports
Physical board end-to-end >=3x target, energy, repeated runs and statistical evidence; never substitute emulation time
Paper, claim matrix, reproducible artifact bundle and gate-by-gate final audit
